id: title:Gilbert09:stop reporting a clock skew s3 delete as a bug

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion worker reliability and incident prevention
review.reason: Adds transient error classification and regression tests for S3 clock-skew PermissionErrors, allowing warehouse ingestion workers to distinguish transient clock-skew blips from permanent permission failures. This prevents unnecessary error-tracking and retry storms while preserving distinction between transient and permanent failures.
review.uncertainty: Assessment relies on supplied hunks; unverified outcomes such as actual production incident avoidance or complete implementation of surrounding context are not independently confirmed.

observations.limitations: All supplied hunks are from a single, conservative grouping of changes. No indication of unrelated PRs. No score assigned.
